nameNumberMeanings.1: a natural leader - independent and driven to start new things
nameNumberMeanings.2: a diplomat - cooperative, sensitive to others, works well in partnership
nameNumberMeanings.3: expressive and creative - drawn to communication and self-expression
nameNumberMeanings.4: grounded and hardworking - values stability and building things that last
nameNumberMeanings.5: adventurous - craves freedom, change, and new experience
nameNumberMeanings.6: nurturing - a natural caretaker, often the one holding family together
nameNumberMeanings.7: thoughtful and analytical - drawn to deeper questions and quiet reflection
nameNumberMeanings.8: ambitious - oriented toward achievement, status, and material success
nameNumberMeanings.9: idealistic - generous, big-picture thinker, drawn to causes bigger than self

Rat: Your resourcefulness is highlighted today - a clever shortcut saves you real time.
A financial opportunity crosses your path. Look closely before committing.
Social energy is high - a conversation today could open an unexpected door.
Ox: Steady, patient effort pays off today more than any shortcut would.
A stubborn streak could cause friction - pick which hills are worth defending.
Good day to finish something you started rather than begin something new.
Tiger: Bold action is favored today - hesitation costs more than a wrong move would.
Watch for a rival or competing interest showing up unexpectedly.
Your confidence draws attention today, for better and for worse.
Rabbit: A gentler pace serves you well - don't let others rush your decisions today.
Home and family matters take priority and reward the attention.
Diplomacy wins where confrontation would only cost you.
Dragon: Big ambitions get a boost today - this is a good day to think bigger, not smaller.
Your natural charisma opens a door - use it deliberately, not carelessly.
A leadership moment presents itself; step into it.
Snake: Trust your instincts today - a decision that felt obvious in hindsight starts here.
Quiet observation serves you better than speaking first today.
A financial matter needs a second, sharper look before you act.
Horse: Restlessness is strong today - channel it into movement, not scattered effort.
Travel or a change of scenery brings clarity on something you've been stuck on.
Independence is favored - a solo effort outperforms a group one today.
Goat: Creative work flows more easily today - a good day to make, not just plan.
Lean on someone you trust today rather than carrying something alone.
A gentle, indirect approach gets further than a direct one.
Monkey: Quick thinking serves you well today - trust the clever solution you find.
Watch for a tendency to overcommit - say yes to less, follow through more.
A playful approach to a serious problem surprisingly works today.
Rooster: Precision and preparation pay off - the details you checked twice matter today.
Your honesty lands well today, even where it's blunt.
A public moment favors you - step forward rather than hang back.
Dog: Loyalty is tested and rewarded today - a relationship deepens through it.
Trust your sense of fairness today, even if it's the harder call.
A protective instinct serves someone close to you well today.
Pig: Generosity comes back around today, sooner than expected.
A comfortable, unhurried pace serves you better than pushing hard.
Enjoy something simple today - it recharges more than you'd expect.

wealth.summary: A wealth-drawing amulet (like a Kumarn Thong or Jatukam Ramathep style) is traditionally sought for this.
wealth.tip: Often paired with the color gold or the wearer's day-color for extra emphasis.

love.summary: A love-and-relationship charm, often worn close to the heart, is traditionally sought for this.
love.tip: Some traditions favor a paired set (worn by two people) over a single charm.

protection.summary: A protective amulet blessed by a respected monk is traditionally carried for this.
protection.tip: Often carried rather than worn visibly, and treated with particular care and respect.

career.summary: A success-and-promotion amulet is traditionally worn for this, often paired with a lucky color at work.
career.tip: Commonly renewed or re-blessed at the start of a new job or a big project.
